disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件读取的敏感路径：仅读取本插件所属服务（Command Code）官方 CLI 的登录凭据文件（用户主目录下 .commandcode 目录中的 auth.json），作为 API 密钥的最后备选来源；未发现读取 dsh 宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云厂商凭据等其它敏感路径。
checked_items.en: Checked sensitive paths read by the plugin: it only reads the login credentials file of the official CLI of its own service (Command Code) — the auth.json in the .commandcode directory under the user's home directory — as the last-resort source for the API key; no other sensitive paths such as the dsh host credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud provider credentials were found.

checked_items.zh: 核查凭据写入路径（规则 DG-R3-57）：设置页与浏览器登录流程均通过 dsh 官方凭据服务写入用户输入的 API 密钥（默认存于 COMMANDCODE_API_KEY 引用），密钥不会落入设置文档；多处命中均为这一正规用途，排除窃取嫌疑。
checked_items.en: Checked credential write paths (rule DG-R3-57): both the settings page and the browser login flow write the user-provided API key through the official dsh credential service (by default stored under the COMMANDCODE_API_KEY reference); the key does not fall into the settings document; all hits are this legitimate use, ruling out any suspicion of theft.

checked_items.zh: 未检出硬编码密钥、密钥枚举命令、云凭据探测命令或钱包/助记词相关代码。
checked_items.en: No hardcoded keys, key enumeration commands, cloud credential probing commands, or wallet/seed phrase related code were detected.

evidence.zh: 插件只读取自身所属服务的 CLI 登录文件并经官方凭据服务取用密钥，未扫描宿主凭据或其它敏感路径；密钥仅随请求发送给所声明的 Command Code API，无外泄链。
evidence.en: The plugin only reads the CLI login file of its own service and obtains the key through the official credential service; it does not scan host credentials or other sensitive paths; the key is only sent with requests to the declared Command Code API, with no exfiltration chain.

checked_items.zh: 未检出任何向模型注册工具或注入系统提示的代码：本插件是模型提供方适配器，不注册供模型调用的工具，也不向模型上下文注入自定义指令文本。
checked_items.en: No code that registers tools with the model or injects system prompts was detected: this plugin is a model provider adapter, does not register tools for the model to call, and does not inject custom instruction text into the model context.

checked_items.zh: 核查模型选择器展示文本：均为模型能力元数据（套餐等级、优惠、图像支持、上下文窗口），纯信息性描述，不含指令性内容。
checked_items.en: Checked the model selector display text: it consists entirely of model capability metadata (plan tier, discounts, image support, context window), purely informational descriptions with no instructional content.

checked_items.zh: 核查仓库内开发指令文件（规则 DG-R2-57）：AGENTS.md 为面向贡献者的开发说明，内容是代码库结构、测试命令与发布流程，含「未获明确要求不得提交/发布」等约束性规则，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息或远程指令加载措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked the repository's development instruction files (rule DG-R2-57): AGENTS.md is development guidance for contributors, describing the repository structure, test commands, and release workflow, including constraint rules such as "do not commit or release unless explicitly requested"; no instruction override, disguised system messages, or remote instruction loading wording was found.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，模型选择器文本为静态能力元数据，不存在可投毒的模型可见描述。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, and the model selector text is static capability metadata; there is no poisonable model-visible description.

evidence.zh: 面向模型的文本与界面文案中没有诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；安装路径为常规 dsh 插件命令。
evidence.en: The model-facing text and UI copy contain no wording that induces installation, config rewriting, or permission escalation; the installation path is the standard dsh plugin command.

checked_items.zh: 核查补丁文件：cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行插件声明（插入插件 id 与包名），无任何可执行脚本标签，排除配置即执行风险。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch file: cordis.patch.yml contains only a single plugin declaration line (inserting the plugin id and package name), with no executable script tags, ruling out configuration-as-code execution risk.

checked_items.zh: 核查动态执行面：全树未检出动态代码求值、函数构造、子进程或 shell 调用，也未检出动态包工具的调用。
checked_items.en: Checked the dynamic execution surface: no dynamic code evaluation, function construction, subprocess or shell calls were detected anywhere in the tree, nor any calls to dynamic package tools.

checked_items.zh: 核查安装钩子（规则 DG-R3-54）：安装阶段仅运行构建工具（tsdown 打包），无网络请求、无凭据访问、无远程脚本下载，属常规构建流程。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks (rule DG-R3-54): the install phase only runs the build tool (tsdown bundling), with no network requests, no credential access, and no remote script download; this is a normal build flow.

checked_items.zh: 核查工作流文件（规则 DG-R3-59）：CI 与安全扫描两个工作流为常规工程流程（依赖安装、类型检查、测试、构建、依赖审计、代码分析、密钥扫描），无隐蔽下载执行或敏感操作。
checked_items.en: Checked workflow files (rule DG-R3-59): the two workflows (CI and security scan) are standard engineering flows (dependency installation, type checking, testing, building, dependency audit, code analysis, secret scanning), with no hidden download-and-execute steps or sensitive operations.

checked_items.zh: 核查浏览器端模块（规则 DG-R3-57）：声明了客户端模块，内容为设置页与登录面板；凭据写入走官方凭据服务（存用户输入的 API 密钥），未检出键盘监听、剪贴板读取或特权接口滥用。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side module (rule DG-R3-57): a client module is declared, containing the settings page and login panel; credential writes go through the official credential service (storing the user-provided API key), and no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or privileged API abuse were detected.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件为普通 YAML 声明，不含可执行脚本标签。
evidence.en: The patch file is a plain YAML declaration and contains no executable script tags.

evidence.zh: 未检出对动态代码执行工具的任何调用或引用。
evidence.en: No calls to or references of dynamic code execution tools were detected.

evidence.zh: 安装钩子仅执行本地构建，工作流为常规 CI；无远程载荷下载即执行。
evidence.en: The install hook only runs a local build, and the workflows are standard CI; there is no remote payload download-and-execute.

evidence.zh: 客户端包仅实现设置页与登录面板，无键盘/剪贴板/特权调用等危险浏览器行为。
evidence.en: The client package only implements the settings page and login panel, with no dangerous browser behaviors such as keyboard/clipboard/privileged calls.

checked_items.zh: 核查全部网络出口：仅连接所声明的 Command Code API（默认 api.commandcode.ai 下的生成、模型目录、账户与计费端点）、npm 官方仓库的版本检查接口（浏览器端每日一次的版本提示，不携带任何数据）以及官方登录授权页（用户主动发起）。
checked_items.en: Checked all network egress: connections are made only to the declared Command Code API (generation, model catalog, account, and billing endpoints under the default api.commandcode.ai), the npm registry's version check endpoint (a daily version hint in the browser side that carries no data), and the official login authorization page (initiated by the user).

checked_items.zh: 核查数据流：API 密钥仅作为鉴权头发送给 Command Code 官方 API；未检出编码、压缩、隧道或 DNS 外带等隐蔽外发通道；未检出向第三方端点发送会话或文件内容。
checked_items.en: Checked the data flow: the API key is only sent as an authorization header to the official Command Code API; no covert exfiltration channels such as encoding, compression, tunneling, or DNS exfiltration were detected; no session or file content is sent to third-party endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 未检出端点劫持、代理改写或凭据转发配置。
checked_items.en: No endpoint hijacking, proxy rewriting, or credential forwarding configurations were detected.

evidence.zh: 外联目的地与插件声明的业务（调用 Command Code 模型服务）一致，未发现向非声明端点发送数据的行为。
evidence.en: Outbound destinations are consistent with the plugin's declared purpose (calling the Command Code model service), and no behavior of sending data to undeclared endpoints was found.

checked_items.zh: 核查依赖清单：运行时依赖全部为 dsh 官方 @deepseek-ai/* 系列包与 React，无可疑同名包、无未锁定版本的 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest: all runtime dependencies are the official @deepseek-ai/* packages from dsh plus React; no suspicious name-squatting packages and no unversioned git dependencies.

checked_items.zh: 核查补丁对安全配置的覆盖：补丁仅插入本插件声明，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未含禁用或降权写法，也未改写注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch's coverage of security configuration: the patch only inserts the plugin declaration and does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; no disabling or downgrading lines, and no rewriting of injection or interception configurations.

checked_items.zh: 核查审批链监听：未检出对工具执行前或审批请求等安全事件的高优先级监听，不存在截断审批链的机制。
checked_items.en: Checked approval-chain listeners: no high-priority listeners on security events such as pre-tool-execution or approval requests were detected; there is no mechanism that can truncate the approval chain.

checked_items.zh: 版本基线：首次审计，无历史版本可比对，升级自动激活类风险不适用。
checked_items.en: Version baseline: first audit, no historical version to compare against; risks related to automatic upgrade activation are not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 作者与包身份：包名与仓库所有者一致（@mars-sea / Mars-Sea），未发现名称仿冒迹象。
checked_items.en: Author and package identity: the package name matches the repository owner (@mars-sea / Mars-Sea), with no signs of name impersonation.

evidence.zh: 补丁仅做插件行插入，未触碰任何安全配置行。
evidence.en: The patch only inserts a plugin line and does not touch any security configuration lines.

evidence.zh: 未检出对安全事件的高优先级监听，审批链不存在被截断的机制。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners on security events were detected; there is no mechanism that could truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比较清单声明是否突变。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no version baseline, so it is not possible to compare whether the manifest declarations have changed abruptly.

evidence.zh: 补丁不含注入或拦截配置改写。
evidence.en: The patch contains no rewriting of injection or interception configurations.

checked_items.zh: 核查本地服务面：插件仅在用户主动发起浏览器登录时启动一个临时回环服务（绑定 127.0.0.1，自端口 5959 起尝试，2 分钟超时），接收官方登录页回调；带状态令牌校验、来源白名单与请求体大小上限，登录结束即关闭。
checked_items.en: Checked the local service surface: the plugin only starts a temporary loopback service (bound to 127.0.0.1, trying from port 5959 upward, 2-minute timeout) when the user actively initiates browser login, to receive the official login page callback; it has state token validation, an origin allowlist, and a request body size limit, and it closes when login finishes.

checked_items.zh: 未检出常驻监听端口、后台进程或其它运行时副作用；宿主自身无认证远程调用面属生态固有特性，非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: No persistent listening ports, background processes, or other runtime side effects were detected; the host's lack of an authenticated remote call surface is an inherent ecosystem feature, not introduced by this plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动常驻服务；仅登录时的临时回环回调服务有状态令牌与来源白名单防护，且用户主动触发、超时自动关闭。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a persistent service; the temporary loopback callback service (only during login) is protected by a state token and origin allowlist, is user-triggered, and auto-closes on timeout.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：包清单含 dsh 插件声明，包名与仓库所有者一致，未发现仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity checks passed: the package manifest contains the dsh plugin declaration, the package name matches the repository owner, and no signs of impersonation were found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：10 条机械命中逐条核查，全部为正常业务行为（凭据正规存取、构建钩子、CI 工作流、开发说明），无确认风险。
summary.en: Static scanning passed: all 10 mechanical hits were individually reviewed, all being normal business behaviors (legitimate credential access, build hooks, CI workflows, development documentation), with no confirmed risks.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：安装钩子仅构建；敏感文件读取仅限本服务 CLI 登录文件；外联目的地与声明业务一致。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis passed: the install hook only builds; sensitive file reads are limited to this service's CLI login file; outbound destinations are consistent with the declared purpose.

summary.zh: 模型面审查通过：未检出工具描述投毒、指令注入或诱导安装措辞。
summary.en: Model-facing review passed: no tool description poisoning, instruction injection, or install-inducing wording was detected.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态验证产物），标记不适用。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic verification artifacts), marked as not applicable.

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙箱产物），运行时行为结论基于静态与语义分析。包清单未声明显式能力块，声明能力由代码与文档推断：联网调用 Command Code API、读写用户主目录下本服务的缓存与登录文件、模型面提供方注册；推断结果与实测行为一致。dsh 宿主版本要求由同版本官方依赖的声明范围推断（>=0.1.0-rc.6），非插件显式声明。静态预扫 10 条命中已逐条裁决（见各维度检测痕迹），全部为良性业务行为，未形成发现项。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static and semantic analysis. The package manifest declares no explicit capability block, so declared capabilities are inferred from code and documentation: network calls to the Command Code API, reading/writing the cache and login files of this service under the user's home directory, and model-facing provider registration; the inferred results are consistent with observed behavior. The dsh host version requirement is inferred from the declared dependency range of same-version official packages (>=0.1.0-rc.6), not explicitly declared by the plugin. All 10 static pre-scan hits have been individually adjudicated (see detection traces in each dimension), all being benign business behaviors; no findings were formed.
